files.icomoon.ttf: exact production file (32,944 bytes), the same on every MNG site

font.extractedFrom: https://www.ocregister.com/wp-content/themes/assets/static/css/boldcoastal.css (embedded @font-face "icomoon"), 2026-10-08. All sites use the same icon font (Karl, 2026-10-08).

designSource: MNG Web Design System (jFHYqhZbJjvWQmDI4myCsd) › Icons | 2026.08.28 › "Icon Categories" (1412:13). Every icon is named by its production class (Karl, 2026-10-22: production names are kept, always). icomoonName is the icon's name in IcoMoon, for finding it there again; it comes from the MNG IcoMoon project (selection.json, 2025-03-19), using the IcoMoon tag where the project renamed an icon. artworkSource "custom" = artwork made or changed by MNG (blue names on the Figma page). Third-party vendor icons (cookies, weather, commenting) are out of scope.

statusKey.match: Production class has this name and glyph
statusKey.production-class-wrong-glyph: Production class with this name shows the wrong glyph; the right glyph is in the font
statusKey.no-production-class: Glyph is in the font but production has no class for it
